recovery_properties: successful call: invocation+PLANNED atomic, tools with no DB transaction, result staged inside M7 acceptance commit, SUCCEEDED+observation atomic
replay after media deletion returns the exact receipt without tool start
known tool failure -> FAILED_BEFORE_ACCEPTANCE, no observation, never rerun
unexpected runtime error or staging failure -> SUBMIT_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN, never rerun
crash after ACCEPTED finalizes on next call without second tool start
expired session after tools keeps result, no finalization
two concurrent exact calls start tools once
auth-off/API key/wrong actor/no token refused before records
changed root -> M10_SUBJECT_STALE, unpublished profile -> M10_PROFILE_STALE, nothing written
stored body or cached digest corruption refuses replay; raw UPDATE/DELETE refused on all three tables
migration upgrade/downgrade/upgrade on SQLite and PostgreSQL preserves predecessor rows

replay survives a retired catalog entry; changed M7 route/request digest refuses replay; receipt construction failure after staging is SUBMIT_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN with no committed result; cancellation leaves no active unit
limits: Not production activation; no public router or default app registration.
Release-mode gating relies on existing require_submit_route semantics.
Unknown outcomes remain operator-reviewed M7 state; A4 has no resolution API.
review_fixes: effective limits = min(published rule, catalog config, host)
replay/finalize cross-check M7 route_json, request digest and provider payload
receipt construction after staging is inside the ambiguous branch
cancellation kills, reaps and verifies the owned unit
DECODE refuses media missing a required stream
